consultation.question: Must shared scene/Director restoration be untrusted presentation intent requiring fresh I01/I06 source/audience admission, never transferable authority?
consultation.answer: Yes. New private release/replay requires complete current influencing-source/grant/rights/purpose/session/device/audience/destination/route/provider/cancel closure and exact-output admission/fresh consumption. Historical receipts cannot remint permits/refund use. Plain scene/view import into intact authority does not itself rotate authority/restore epoch; authority/evidence persistence rollback or lost continuity is a distinct restore protocol. Embedded grants/permits/jobs cannot resume by import.
